11                ACTING PRESIDENT BENJAMIN:   Senator 

12   Borrello to explain his vote.

13                SENATOR BORRELLO:   Thank you, 

14   Mr. President.

15                These are certainly unusual times.  

16   And as the newest member of this Legislature, I 

17   stand here in awe of the people, the everyday 

18   heroes, that are now on the front lines of this 

19   crisis -- our first responders, our healthcare 

20   workers -- and I want to start by thanking them.

21                You know, during this unprecedented 

22   time in our state, with so much uncertainty, we 

23   had the opportunity to pass a clean budget that 

24   was devoid of policy and politics.  We missed 

25   that opportunity.  A budget that does not violate 


                                                                1351

 1   our state and federal constitutions by including 

 2   so many policy items that it really should not.

 3                Sadly, these first two bills are 

 4   just politics as usual, with so much bad policy 

 5   that I cannot support them.  The bill cuts out 

 6   the Small Business Tax Credit.  It further 

 7   infringes on our United States constitutional 

 8   rights.  It raises taxes in this time right now 

 9   when people are hanging on by a thread.  It 

10   further burdens our taxpayers, our small 

11   businesses, and our local governments.  

12                In this unprecedented time we could 

13   have changed the way this state does business, 

14   changed it for the better.  Sadly, we missed that 

15   opportunity.  

16                So Mr. President, I'll be voting no.

17                Thank you.
